lines.t: In the garden where we fell, you were standing out of sight
Coats of skin on all our shame, blood was on the edge of life
Abel at his little altar, lifting up a firstborn cry
Fruit and sweat from Cain below, but only one caught your eye
Noah on that mountain high, with the smoke against the sky
Clean hearts on a burning stone, while the flood was running dry
Abraham on Moriah heard his only son ask
Where's the lamb?
You gave a ram to save him then
Still pointing to the great I am
Every shadow, every sign, every altar
In the night was a whisper from forever
About a sacrifice outside of time
You were slain from the foundation, but forever you're alive
Every heartbeat, every nation, built from darkness into light
All my hustle from the ground, still can't reach your holy throne
But your blood keeps singing over me, child you're not alone
From the garden to the rainbow, to the cross and to the throne
You were slain from the foundation and you'll never let me go
Cain brought you his power, everything his hands could raise
Abel brought dependence Laying down his breath in praise
One was saying, look at me One was, look at what you've done
You reached across the ages Answered all of it in your son
Every seed that breaks in darkness Every winter losing light
Every quiet hidden chrysalis Waking up with brand new sight
Every sunrise after midnight Is creation singing back
About the lamb who walked through death His self and never once looked back
Every season, every sign, every fall and every rise
Is a deeper revelation of the cross of all time
Oh, you were slain from the foundation
But forever you're alive
Every heartbeat, every nation
Pulled from darkness into light
All my hustle from the ground
Still can't reach your holy throne
But your blood keeps singing over me
Child, I call you my own
From the garden to the rainbow
To the cross and to the throne
You were slain from the foundation
And you're never letting go
Before the first word I've spoken
Before the dust was ever formed
You are the thorns inside the promise You are the nails within your heart
And no time will you have not risen And no time will you have not left
Every saint of every season breathes because of who you are
It's not what I can build for heaven It's what heaven built for me
Now my hands are upon the altar
But your hands are upon the tree
You were slain from the foundation
But forever you're alive
Every heartbeat, every nation
Pulled from darkness into light
All my hustle from the ground
Falls like dust before your throne
But your blood keeps singing over us
I have made you my own
From the garden to the rainbow
To the cross and to the door
You were slain from the foundation
And you're never letting go
Every night and every morning
Every seed and every stone
Tell the story of the lamb who was and is and is to come
And is bringing his own home
